item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/May/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will form over central China and develop into a cold front gradually in the next couple of days. The cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China later on Sunday, bringing showers and squally thunderstorms to the region. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, it will be slightly cooler over the coast of Guangdong early next week. A fresh easterly airstream will affect the region midweek next week.
